scope: /ubus JSON-RPC call with uhttpd option no_ubusauth 1: SID rewrite plus skip of uh_ubus_allowed; no luci-ssl ACL grants
assumptions: uhttpd ubus.c uh_ubus_handle_request_object skips uh_ubus_allowed / session.access when conf.ubus_noauth is set. That skip is not an ACL grant and is not luci-ssl-25.12 (that profile has no_ubusauth=0).

An empty string SID is rewritten to UH_UBUS_DEFAULT_SID when conf.ubus_noauth is set. Typed array parsing skips mismatched values; a null or omitted SID slot does not preserve later positional fields.
A gate allow assumes ubus_lookup_id succeeds. Object lookup failure returns ERROR_OBJECT before authorization; plugin execution and its outcome are unmodeled.
Stock luci-ssl-25.12 ships commented option no_ubusauth 0. This profile is the operator-enabled variant option no_ubusauth 1 / uhttpd -a.
Skip-allows do not emit policy_grant rows. Unauthenticated luci-ssl ACLs still name only luci.getFeatures; that ACL is not consulted here.
unknowns: Live rpcd and uhttpd were not executed; decisions are transcribed from pinned C and the stock uhttpd UCI/init overlay.
This slice is the uhttpd /ubus JSON-RPC HTTP gate only. Plugin-side session checks, if any, are not modeled. Stock luci.getFeatures has none.
cgi-io and dispatcher admin/ubus are outside this slice and unaffected. The flag also skips uhttpd /call/<object> and GET subscription authorization; those paths are unmodeled here.
